I am a graduate student in Applied Statistics at Qingdao University. My research interests lie in statistical machine learning, with a particular focus on functional data analysis and transfer learning.

My current research focuses on statistical methodology for learning from heterogeneous and related data sources. I document my research and related methodological ideas in my blog, with concise project summaries available on the Research page.

## Research Interests

- Statistical Machine Learning
- Multi-task and Transfer Learning
- Functional and High-dimensional Data Analysis
- Statistical Foundations of Modern AI
